verdict.rationale: Clerk documents an official remote MCP server that AI agents such as Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot can connect to. Beyond SDK snippets, it exposes account tools for creating and configuring applications, managing users, and setting up production instances. Connection is backed by a dedicated client-connection guide (CIMD and Dynamic Client Registration), a one-command CLI setup, and a probe confirming the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
